title: Predicate preserved by defaulted list access
statement: Let $p$ be a predicate on a type, let $l$ be a finite list of elements of that type, and let $d$ be a default value. If $p$ holds of $d$ and of every entry of $l$, then $p$ holds of the entry selected from $l$ at any natural-number index, where out-of-range access returns $d$.
